description: Treasury bill yield calculator — Offline T-bill math (spreadsheet TBILLPRICE / TBILLYIELD / TBILLEQ conventions). Give maturity=YYYY-MM-DD or weeks= (4-52), optional settlement= (default today), and ONE of discount= (bank discount rate %), price= (per 100) or yield= (bond-equivalent %). Returns price per 100, bank discount rate, money-market yield, bond-equivalent (investment) yield, effective annual yield, and cost/interest for face= (default 1000). Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_tbill
